dedupe_keys.name: ugv nbwaste barisal oriented non biodegradable waste images

description: UGV-NBWASTE provides images and oriented bounding-box annotations for eight non-biodegradable waste classes in Barisal, Bangladesh. The research contributors report 3,600 smartphone images showing bottles, hard plastic, masks, medicine packets, other packets, polythene, expanded-polystyrene pieces and plastic sandals. Indoor and outdoor conditions include floating or partly buried objects. The article describes cleaning, brightness adjustment and resizing to 640 by 640 pixels. Mendeley version 3 lists 7,202 files, including JPEG images and TXT annotations, with free access under CC BY 4.0. Geographic coverage is selected local collection sites, and acquisition dates were not established. Regional selection and preprocessing are limitations for industrial-line or other-country transfer. Modellers could calibrate object-detection components in waste-collection simulations. data-waste-concern-bangladesh-waste-database supplies separate national waste context. The metadata file count was checked, but image-annotation pairing, labels and detection performance were not audited or downloaded.
